fusions.name: Rake Out
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy and uses up one of your afflictions on it. The strike deals 9 damage and leaves the enemy 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions.

fusions.name: Bitter Slurry
fusions.desc: A burst that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it, and you restore 8 health.

fusions.name: Lime Poultice
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Tight Pointing
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and your poison resistance rises by 10%.
